purpose: Exploratory child routing and low-vs-medium calibration, not confirmatory non-inferiority evidence

execution.route: existing OpenAI Codex subscription only; no OpenRouter or direct paid API
execution.comparison_unit: same task across candidate model/effort pairs; repetitions are not independent tasks
execution.isolation: fresh ephemeral child; identical production guard, system prompt, tools, fixture and output bounds
execution.low_control: temporary models.json only; observe effective and wire thinking, reject clamping before request
execution.order: seeded task and candidate order per repetition
execution.raw_content: retain synthetic final answers only; no intermediate tool output or private source content
execution.parent_synthesis: excluded to isolate child model effects; six separate production smoke cells test end-to-end delegation

score.primary: All exact typed answer fields plus valid line ranges covering required evidence groups and nonempty explanation
score.runtime_gate: complete, untruncated, observed request/response model and actual effective/wire reasoning match
score.manual_check: parent audits substantive explanations and no-defect control; not an independent blinded judge
score.limitations: Structured answer checks are not a general quality score; no statistical non-inferiority or production-generalization claim

decision_rules.default: Keep existing three medium presets unless quality and practical efficiency evidence support changing them
decision_rules.astra: Do not replace inexpensive routing solely on release or brand. Add a specialist preset only with a distinct demonstrated capability/quality need
decision_rules.low: Report a task type as a provisional low candidate only if both low repeats meet answer/evidence/runtime checks and paired token or latency results show practical benefit; do not relax global low policy automatically
decision_rules.inconclusive: Retain current routing and describe coverage gaps; no unplanned extra model calls to force significance

pricing_notes: Short-context standard API-equivalent estimates from official pages, not Codex bills or quota conversion. Pi's cached Sol catalog still contains 5/30, so catalog cost is retained but not used for comparisons.
